# Skills

Every skill in `stow/agents/.agents/skills/`, linked into `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`.
"Invoked by: you" means the skill only runs when you type its name; "you or agents" means agents can also start it from its description.
Owner comes from `.skill-sources.tsv`; see [CONTEXT.md](../CONTEXT.md) for the terms.
